title: Food court in MallWorld
content: Does anybody else have a food court in their dreams? There’s this one area in this mall like location I dream about all the time. It’s an open concept like a mall with the brown and grey-ish tile on the floor. Theres the fake dark green plants in the middle of the floor and tables to the left of the plant area. The very first restaurant you see is on the left side as well. It’s like a big shape, kinda like a slice of an orange peel reaching from the left to right (if looking at the restaurant) and there’s workers there. Their uniforms are yellow or orange shirts, black pants, red aprons, and red visor hats. I was able to get a glimpse of one of the workers. White, male, 6ft+, dark brown or black hair, skinny, looking to his right at the cash register of the restaurant. There’s a drink machine behind him on his left with cups. The tables are all 4 seaters, some tables had 2 or 4 chairs. To the right of the restaurant (if looking at the restaurant) there seems to be a light tan ramp that leads somewhere. I’ve never went up the ramp but I’ve came down from it but don’t remember where I was coming from. There are other people around but can’t really make out their faces. I’m not sure if what I’m about to say will make sense but if you are old enough to know how the late 90’s/early 2000’s looked and felt you will understand this. The air felt cooler and lighter, every color was so vivid and bright even if it was dark, the skies were a true blue and clouds were fluffier, there was a feeling of rest, a moment of ease, and overall everything felt better than what it is now. Maybe that’s just what I want things to be like and it’s showing in my dreams but if you know, you know. Has anyone else experienced this place? I’ll try to get a picture of it drawn up from my point of view.
